title: feat(state): contract hardening from the first writers — records verb, write result record, teaching refusals
context:
Three additive changes, each from a defect a real writer hit on the live pilot:

- A refused idempotency key now names the differing fields and the way out (re-send the
  original payload to replay, or use a new key; the record keeps its derived id and is
  updated in place). Sofia's summaries hit exactly this: same evidence, same identity,
  new wording, same key, permanent refusal.
- WriteResult.record returns the record as stored, so a writer verifies what landed.
- A `records` verb (nuryel.s Touches invariant(s): con_902759b3dc (All JSON writes to .hunch/ must be atomic (temp-file + rename) so an interrupted write can never truncate the index); con_a87360128b (Semantic vectors are a derived layer in SQLite, never the source of truth; reconcile by content hash on reindex); con_e04226bd05 (The MCP server must stay client-agnostic: all assistants point to the same .hunch/ graph; no Claude-only behavior in the server).
decision: Introduced src/client, src/core, src/mcp, src/serve, src/store, test/mcp-state.test.ts: added RecordsRequest, RecordsResponse, differingFields, recordsState.
